programme.desc: A Borboleta Baby e os seus amigos animais recordam os momentos divertidos que passaram juntos, como o dia em que foram à praia, fizeram truques de magia, ou brincaram numa banda Eles resolvem os seus problemas, porque sabem que sua amizade é o mais importante

programme.title: Bath Tubbies
programme.desc: Brinca na água e prepara-te para uma aventura na banheira com a Ellie, o Frogy e o Ducky, os teus novos brinquedos na hora do banho Junta-te a eles enquanto flutuam, brincam com bolhas e inventam novos jogos com sabão e frascos de champô, na casa de banho da diversão

programme.title: Olha O Que Encontrei
programme.desc: Uma criança entra num quarto e descobre um objeto doméstico. A história desenrola no quarto assim como na imaginação do menino, onde cada objeto se transforma em algo divertido e surpreendente. Um sapato transforma-se num carro, um pedaço de papel num avião e muito mais A série apresenta-nos a interação com pequenos objetos a par com a imaginação da criança, que pode transformar um objeto em algo maior do que a vida

programme.title: Cuddlies
programme.desc: O quarteto favorito da BabyTV, os Cuddlies, apresenta uma série de histórias divertidas do mundo dos mais pequenos. Junta-te aos nossos adoráveis amiguinhos e aprende o que é a colaboração, a partilha e o carinho, enquanto os quatro se ajudam mutuamente a resolver dilemas simples de uma forma divertida e amigável.

programme.desc: Fecha os olhos, encosta-te e relaxa. Está na hora de ires para a cama.

programme.title: Recechando Al Límite
programme.desc: Los montes pasiegos, en Cantabria, son un verdadero paraíso para la codorniz, que decide pasar los meses más calurosos del verano al resguardo de las altas temperaturas de la meseta. programme.title: Microjigging Pela Costa Brava
programme.desc: Nueva serie de 12 capítulos donde trataremos todos los aspectos que engloban la caza con arco, con especial atención al correcto uso y manejo del arco de poleas. Ajustes, flechas, puntas de caza, visores y técnicas de tiro serán los protagonistas de este viaje de 12 entregas para enriquecer nuestros conceptos sobre el arco.

programme.title: Codornices Pasiegas
programme.desc: As amostras duras são uma excelente alternativa nos meses de outubro e novembro para encontrar os bons achigãs e é exatamente isso que fizemos, com a particularidade de que antes e as meter na água estivemos com Javi Mohi, um pintor artesão deste tipo de amostras, que conta com uma larga experiência a pintar este utensílio que nos serviu para poder dar forma a duas delas, feitas exclusivamente para esta reportagem.

programme.title: Os Segredos Do Arco T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: A caça de aquáticas durante o inverno é uma modalidade cada vez mais praticada em plena Terra de Campos. programme.title: Mohi, Amostras Duras
programme.desc: Llegamos al siglo XXI con el Ruger Predator Gen II. Materiales modernos, calibres de alta velocidad y ópticas de última generación con torretas balísticas muestran hasta qué punto ha evolucionado la tecnología aplicada a la caza. En este episodio exploramos cómo un equipo moderno permite realizar disparos precisos a largas distancias poniendo de manifiesto el enorme avance técnico que han experimentado los rifles a lo largo del tiempo.

programme.title: Rifles: De La Batalla A La Caza - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Penetramos en las transparentes aguas del embalse de Bolarque, en la provincia de Guadalajara. programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas. Caza menor con perros de grouses o pequeños urogallos, o en puestos de patos, barnaclas o gansos blancos.

programme.desc: España estuvo a punto de decir adiós al oso pardo en la década de los 90 y en 2026 tenemos más población que en las últimas décadas,Se trata de uno de los mayores logros de recuperación de una especie en la historia de nuestro país junto al lince ibérico. Este aumento de oso pardo en España conlleva retos que pasan por una coexistencia efectiva con las personas donde comparte territorio.

programme.title: Caça Menor Em Las Botiosas
programme.desc: Caça Menor Em Las Botiosas

programme.title: A Fondo - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Una temporada más el club Monteiros do Norte celebra su multitudinaria monteria con mas de 300 cazadores llegados de toda Portugal. Una monteria que va más allá de la caza..

programme.title: Pesca En Peligro De Extinción: Barbada Con Vara
programme.desc: Después de unos años difíciles para corzos y corceros debido a la drástica reducción de las poblaciones de este pequeño cérvido, volvemos a La Rioja y lo hacemos para disfrutar de sendos recechos con Rebeca y José Gabriel. Como siempre, el duende del bosque no lo pondrá fácil: hembras, crías, incluso un gato montés se va a cruzar en nuestro camino pero dar con un corzo veterano es otro cantar.

programme.title: Monteando Na Serra D'Ossa
programme.desc: En este capítulo de Carnaza nos visita Juan Morillo, un padre de familia en busca de recetas fáciles y divertidas que poder compartir con los suyos. Junto a Iván cocinaremos la reina de nuestras aves de caza, la perdiz roja, creando dos platos fríos que no os dejarán indiferentes.

programme.title: Carnaza T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: La actividad cinegética tiene un enorme calado en las zonas interiores de Portugal. Cada montería y cada feria de caza se convierten en un evento importante y en un impulso económico que se celebra como una verdadera fiesta. Las autoridades locales y regionales son conscientes y apoyan con firmeza cualquier celebración relacionada con el campo, el mundo rural y sus actividades ancestrales.

programme.title: Carnaza T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A partir da localidade de Vegacervera entramos nas montanhas de Riaño caçando de aproximação o esquivo rebeco e aproveitamos os rios de montanha como é o caso do Torio para pescar as suas trutas bravas com Pablo Castro.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Angel es un gran conocedor de las armas y de los calibres así como de la recarga. En esta ocasión le acompañamos en unas salidas al campo donde disfrutaremos junto a él de su destreza y pasión por este mundo que lo lleva a la caza.

programme.title: Cozinha Selvagem Com Diego Gallegos T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: El mítico Karabiner 98k, uno de los rifles militares más reconocidos de la historia, es el protagonista de este episodio. Fabricado con materiales de primer nivel y una acción que marcó un antes y un después, demostró una precisión excepcional. Hoy sale del campo de batalla para afrontar un reto muy distinto: la gestión de una cierva y demostrar que, décadas después, sigue siendo un rifle extraordinariamente preciso.

programme.title: Rifles: De La Batalla A La Caza - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Penetramos en las transparentes aguas del embalse de Bolarque, en la provincia de Guadalajara. programme.title: O Atum De Ponta A Ponta T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Nueva serie de 12 capítulos donde trataremos todos los aspectos que engloban la caza con arco, con especial atención al correcto uso y manejo del arco de poleas. Ajustes, flechas, puntas de caza, visores y técnicas de tiro serán los protagonistas de este viaje de 12 entregas para enriquecer nuestros conceptos sobre el arco.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En Macedo
programme.desc: Bonifacio es un veterano galguero que lleva más de medio siglo participando en el campeonato nacional de galgos. Galguero querido y respetado por todo el gremio, sigue con la misma pasión cuidando y preparando a sus galgos.

programme.title: Os Segredos Do Arco T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Nuestro chef se desplaza hasta Colombia para visitar una de sus ganaderias tradicionales. Carne de lujo para elaborar sus mejores platos.

programme.title: Os Segredos Do Arco T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: A caça de aquáticas durante o inverno é uma modalidade cada vez mais praticada em plena Terra de Campos. As numerosas lagoas que se formam durante os meses de inverno fazem destas jornadas um verdadeiro prazer onde o cão desempenha um papel muito importante, levantando e cobrando a peça de caça apesar do intenso frio castelhano.

programme.title: Recechando Al Límite
programme.desc: Mario viaja hasta el Amazonas en busca de grandes peces y 'sufre' una ceremonia de iniciación a manos de una tribu local donde es literalmente envenenado con sustancias alucinógenas.

programme.title: Microjigging Pela Costa Brava
programme.desc: Microjigging Pela Costa Brava

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Entramos nas montanhas leonesas à procura do rei do bosque numa temporada pouco habitual devido à escassez da berreia do veado. A berreia está no seu ponto forte e os timidos veados berreiam pouco e quando o fazem é nas profundezas do bosque, a paciência vai ser a arma principal para poder acabar com o êxito esta caçada. Dois dias de uma dura expedição que culminaram com o cobro de um trofeu majestoso.

programme.title: Feeder Free Em Fortaleny
programme.desc: De la mano del Campeón Mundial de Pesca a Mosca, David Arcay, vamos a conocer la Galicia más auténtica en los entornos de los ríos más representativos de esta fantástica región del norte. David, pescando a mosca y a ninfa, nos mostrará cuál es el estado actual de las diferentes especies, sobresaliendo entre ellas una trucha esquiva, fuerte y sobre todo combativa.

programme.title: Play Caza T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Acompanhámos Josep e Gerard até às águas da Costa Brava em busca do pargo com a técnica do microjigging. Ao longo deste reportagem, eles irão ensinar-nos truques e materiais que devem ser utilizados se pretendermos ter jornadas bem-sucedidas com esta modalidade.

programme.desc: O primeiro “Ó da Casa” é dedicado ao hall de entrada. A arquiteta e apaixonada por design de interiores Joana Laranjeira abre a porta da sua oficina para criar de raiz um cabide/ bengaleiro e transformar um banco antigo num banco com sapateira.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hoje a sala é a protagonista. Joana surpreende com 2 projetos muito criativos. Partindo de um simples material, como uma chapa metálica, cria um elegante candeeiro de teto e reutilizando surpreendentes peças usadas, constrói uma mesa de centro.

programme.title: Prova De Amizade T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A chef Marlene e o chef João Sá recebem os próximos convidados, Inês Lopes Gonçalves e Júlio Isidro. No entanto, João percebe que deixou a cataplana no restaurante e tem de ir ao vizinho pedir uma emprestada.

programme.title: O Torneio
programme.desc: Numa cidade no norte de Inglaterra, um torneio é assistido por dezenas de homens ricos, com 30 concorrentes que estão dispostos a tudo para ganhar um prémio de 10 milhões de dólares. O objetivo é simples: matar todos os adversários e ser o último sobrevivente de todos.

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros…

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: O Homem Dos Punhos De Ferro 2
programme.desc: Quando Thaddeus, um estranho misterioso, recupera de ferimentos numa pequena vila na China do século XIX, envolve-se no conflito que coloca o povo do vilarejo contra o maldoso Mestre Ho e o nefasto clã Beetle. Com Thaddeus ao seu lado, o bem educado Li Kung transforma-se num guerreiro mortal.

programme.title: Parasitas
programme.desc: Uma família coreana no desemprego começa a ter um interesse peculiar por uma outra, com um estilo de vida cheio de glamour, até que todos se envolvem num acontecimento absolutamente inesperado.

programme.title: Le Chant Du Loup - Ameaça Em Alto Mar
programme.desc: Chanteraide tem o raro dom de conseguir identificar todos os sons que ouve. A bordo de um submarino nuclear francês, tudo depende dele, só que, reputado como infalível, ele acaba por cometer um erro que coloca toda a equipa em perigo de morte.

programme.title: Zona 414
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, numa colónia de robôs humanoides, o detetive particular David Carmichael é contratado para encontrar a filha desaparecida do excêntrico criador dos andróides que integram aquela comunidade.

programme.title: No Lugar Errado
programme.desc: Um “cozinheiro” de metanfetaminas persegue o ex-chefe de polícia de uma pequena cidade a fim de o silenciar antes que ele testemunhe contra a sua família, só que acaba por ver-se confrontado com muito mais do que o que estava à espera.

programme.title: O Chacal
programme.desc: Quando um impiedoso assassino conhecido como Chacal é contratado para eliminar um elemento importante do governo dos EUA, o diretor-adjunto do FBI vai resgatar à prisão um atirador do IRA para juntos deterem o misterioso mercenário antes que ele consiga levar a cabo a sua mortífera missão.

programme.title: Missão Inesperada
programme.desc: Jim Hanson, um ex-atirador de elite do exército, vive junto à isolada fronteira entre os EUA e o México e torna-se inesperadamente o protetor de um menino mexicano, quando um perigoso cartel de droga mata a mãe do rapaz e os começa a perseguir de forma implacável.

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: Backtrace Rasto De Violência
programme.desc: Após ficar ferido gravemente durante um assalto, MacDonald perde a memória e é colocado na ala psiquiátrica de uma prisão de alta segurança. Sete anos passados, é contactado por outro prisioneiro que lhe oferece ajuda para fugir da prisão…

programme.title: As Voltas Da Vida
programme.desc: Mickey é uma advogada que tenta recuperar a relação disfuncional que tem com o seu pai, um prestigiado mas envelhecido olheiro de basebol, acompanhando-o numa viagem de recrutamento que pode ser a ultima da sua carreira.

programme.title: O Homem Dos Punhos De Ferro 2
programme.desc: Quando Thaddeus, um estranho misterioso, recupera de ferimentos numa pequena vila na China do século XIX, envolve-se no conflito que coloca o povo do vilarejo contra o maldoso Mestre Ho e o nefasto clã Beetle. Com Thaddeus ao seu lado, o bem educado Li Kung transforma-se num guerreiro mortal.

programme.title: Sucker Punch - Mundo Surreal
programme.desc: Uma jovem é internada num hospício contra a sua vontade. Como estratégia para lidar com tudo, ela recua para uma extravagante realidade alternativa onde se junta a quatro prisioneiras que se tornam guerreiras experientes com a missão de recolher os quatro itens que lhes permitam fugir.

programme.title: Boss Level - O Último Nível
programme.desc: Preso num “loop” temporal que repete constantemente o dia que desemboca na sua morte, Roy Pulver, um antigo agente das forças especiais, empreende uma corrida contra o tempo para tentar acumular informação que evite o seu desfecho fatal e salve a mulher que ama.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 3
programme.desc: Quando a filha de um magnata da tecnologia de Hong Kong é atirada para uma prisão de segurança máxima na Letónia, o especialista em segurança Ray Breslin é contratado para resgatá-la. Só que a namorada dele também é raptada e a missão já de si difícil passa a ser de vida ou de morte.

programme.title: Todo O Dinheiro Do Mundo
programme.desc: Quando o neto de 16 anos do homem mais rico do mundo, John Paul Getty, é raptado, a família recebe um pedido de resgate exorbitante, que o milionário se recusa a pagar. Com a vida do filho em jogo, Gail alia-se ao braço direito de Getty para tentar resolver a situação.

programme.title: Gringo
programme.desc: Harold Soyinka é um pacato homem de negócios enviado ao México para fechar um negócio para a farmacêutica em que trabalha. Mas assim que lá aterra, acontecem-lhe as mais insólitas aventuras e ele deixa de ser um cidadão respeitoso para passar a ser um criminoso procurado.

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: Sombras Da Escuridão
programme.desc: Barnabas Collins é um vampiro que, após ter sido enterrado vivo por 196 anos, regressa ao mundo dos vivos e à sua casa ancestral no Maine, onde encontra os seus descendentes absolutamente disfuncionais e a necessitar da sua proteção.

programme.title: Uma Casa Cheia
programme.desc: Alice Kinney vive em Los Angeles com as duas filhas. Com 40 anos e solteira, ela vai ver a sua vida sofrer uma grande reviravolta quando, a pedido da mãe, consente que três jovens atraentes vão viver temporariamente em sua casa.

programme.title: O Rei Escorpião: A Ascensão Do Guerreiro
programme.desc: Saiba como começou a lenda do Rei Escorpião. Quando o jovem Mathayus testemunha a morte do pai às mãos do rei, a sua demanda por vingança transforma-o no mais temido guerreiro da Antiguidade.

programme.title: Conspiração Terrorista
programme.desc: Alice Racine é uma agente da CIA não conseguiu evitar um ataque terrorista que dizimou dezenas de vítimas e que é forçada a voltar à ação para tentar neutralizar um brutal ataque ao território britânico com uma arma biológica.

programme.title: Perigosa Clarividência
programme.desc: Jian Huang é um agente da brigada de antiterrorismo com capacidades singulares tanto de artes marciais como de clarividência, que tenta investigar a verdade sobre a morte do irmão.

programme.title: O Último A Cair
programme.desc: Após uma pandemia ter dizimado o mundo, o antigo soldado John Wood vive isolado numa floresta até lhe aparecer a pedir ajuda uma mulher ferida que parece ter o segredo para acabar com o vírus.

programme.title: Emboscada
programme.desc: Durante a guerra do Vietname, um grupo de comandos de elite americanos, liderados pelo Capitão Drummond, são encarregues de recolher informação altamente confidencial numa missão arriscada que poderá mudar por completo o rumo do conflito.

programme.title: Sin City: Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: Delibes - Lakmé
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin (1963) leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Léo Delibes’s tragic opera Lakmé (1883). Written to a libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille, the opera is set in nineteenth-century British India and tells the story of Lakmé, who falls in love with Gérald, a British officer.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures!

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 14, KV 449
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris.

programme.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 36 'Linz'
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Chamber music
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. On the program are Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79; and Missa brevis in G major, BWV 236. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 5 BWV 1018
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 5 BWV 1014 is the fifth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: Sibelius – Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: We all know 'The Four Seasons of Vivaldi', it is one of the 'hits' of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi’s famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV?

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sophia Burgos (USA, 1991) and pianist Daniel Gerzenberg (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Ich esse nun mein Brod nicht trocken mehr’, ‘Wer rief dich den?’, ‘Schweig’ einmal still, du garst’ger Schwätzer dort!

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia, recorded on September 27, 2021. Opening the program is a cello performance by Bronzi with the Orchestra da Camera di Peruglia: the Andante cantabile from Joseph Haydn’s Symphony No. 13 in D major, Hob. I:13.

programme.title: Ravel - Sonata for violin and piano in G major
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano (No. 2) in G major, M. 77. The sonata consists of three movements. The piece is often listed as “No. 2”, yet the composer wrote his actual second sonata, which remained unpublished until 38 years after his death, before this one. This performance was recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in this touching performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 9 in D major. Written in 1908-1909, it was the last symphony Mahler completed. Initially, the superstitious composer, believing in the so-called ‘curse of the ninth,’ did not want to write a Symphony No. 9.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed 'Farewell' because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas.

programme.title: Arvo Pärt - Kanon Pokajanen
programme.desc: Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. The canon symbolizes the change, the transformation from day to night, the Old and New Testament, prophecy and the fulfillment, the here and now and the hereafter.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 25 And Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Stefano Conticello leads the Orchestra of Teatro Comunale di Bologna in a Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart program. The concert opens with the Overture from Mozart’s popular opera “The Magic Flute”. This is followed by Piano Concerto No. 25 in C major, K. 503, with Maurizio Baglini as the featured soloist. Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 25 is just one of the twelve great piano concertos he composed during 1784 and 1786.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn And Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Sergei Prokofiev based his ballet ‘Romeo and Juliet’ on William Shakespeare's famous play of the same name, telling the story of two young lovers from the feuding families Montague and Capulet. Acclaimed French choreographer Jean-Christophe Maillot created a distinctive choreography of the ballet in 1996, which has been performed to great success the world over.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016
programme.desc: On Saturday, August 27, 2016, OVG and Sinfonia Rotterdam presented a new Veerhavenconcert under the direction of Conrad van Alphen. As part of this annual event presented in the port of Rotterdam, the musicians perform on a floating stage, and audiences watch the show on the dock and on boats.

programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T8 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Alguns dos teóricos e das mentes mais brilhantes do planeta explorem os limites do conhecimento humano e explicam a ciência por detrás das regras do universo.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T8 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A 26 mil anos luz, no centro da galáxia, encontra-se um gigantesco buraco negro. Como é possível estudar algo tão longínquo e o que poderá ensinar aos cientistas?

programme.title: A História Do Universo T8 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Alguns dos teóricos e das mentes mais brilhantes do planeta explorem os limites do conhecimento humano e explicam a ciência por detrás das regras do universo.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T8 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Algumas das mentes e teóricos mais brilhantes do planeta exploram os limites do conhecimento humano e explicam a ciência por detrás das regras do universo.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T8 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A Terra gira num eixo inclinado enquanto orbita em torno do Sol. Os especialistas e cientistas explicam como o planeta se move na Via Láctea.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Já houve vida em Marte - mas os cientistas acreditam que uma série de extinções devastadoras em massa transformaram um planeta aquoso num deserto.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Quais são os processos de produção por detrás das bombas hidráulicas de direção e tigelas de comida asiática?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T10 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo barris de aço, apitos e comboios em miniatura.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T10 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo cones de gelado, atrelados, graxa e alicates.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Mike encontra um icónico Toyota Célica de 1973. Ele pensa numa solução económica para o motor enquanto Ant põe a sua habilidade de produção à prova.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T18 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O vendedor de automóveis, Mike Brewer, está no Reino Unido! Com o mecânico craque, Marc «Elvis» Priestley, a missão é procurar e restaurar carros icónicos para vender e lucrar.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Parker descobre uma frota de escavadoras monstruosas de 110 toneladas a retirar terra do leito do rio na selva boliviana. Porém, acontece um acidente quando chega ao ouro.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Parker descobre uma frota de escavadoras monstruosas de 110 toneladas a retirar terra do leito do rio na selva boliviana. Porém, acontece um acidente quando chega ao ouro.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Parker invade a zona de ouro da Bolívia para explorar um terreno virgem que pode conter dois milhões de onças de ouro, mesmo onde Butch Cassidy andou em tempos.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T7 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Sempre levados ao limite pelos elementos, circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilcher continuam a trabalhar juntos em família para manter o valioso património das suas terras.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T7 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Sempre levados ao limite pelos elementos, circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilcher continuam a trabalhar juntos em família para manter o valioso património das suas terras.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T12 - Ep. 3

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa enquanto descobrimos como são feitos. Neste episódio: binóculos, mini fogo de artifício, botas de borracha e lâminas circulares.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa enquanto descobrimos como são feitos. Neste episódio: modelos anatómicos, juke boxes, aperitivos de milho e velas de automóveis.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa enquanto descobrimos como são feitos. Neste episódio: lápis, reciclagem de metal e café.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo dardos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Saiba como se produz o vidro industrial, máquinas de lavar, baralhos de cartas e arcos e flechas.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir câmaras de cinema, decorações de Natal feitas de vidro e pneus gigantes.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir microfones, banheiras, relva sintética e canecas de cerveja.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir hot rods, ovos decorativos, bicos de mangueiras e bolas de basebol.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir acordeões, ananases e articulações artificiais.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Quais são os processos de produção por detrás dos extratores de óleos vegetais e cápsulas de café?

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Michael e Maria Start restauram um jogo de arcada de futebol dos anos 50. Michael trabalha na mecânica e Maria as camisolas para todos os jogadores.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Rebecca Pritchard confia a sua herança, uma estátua de querubim carinhosamente conhecida como Fat Les, ao escultor Nick Elphick, que a deve restaurar.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 92
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 98
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 80
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 41
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 76
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 36
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: 'Long Tall Dexter' Live in '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64?features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: John Lewis: Piano Solo
programme.desc: Pianist John Lewis, co-founder and long-time leader of the legendary Modern Jazz Quartet, wrote jazz history with that band. His ability to blend classical forms with jazz improvisations singled him out as a unique artist, who was capable of transcending every musical barrier. When the Modern Jazz Quartet retired, John Lewis continued to work with other musicians and as a solo pianist.

programme.title: Teddy Wilson - Théâtre de l’Atelier
programme.desc: Decades after the 1930s swing era came to an end, one of its giants, pianist Teddy Wilson (1912–1986), kept the flame of this music alive during countless international concert tours. During a hectic spring tour of Europe, the acclaimed pianist appeared at Geneva’s Théâtre de l’Atelier on March 21, 1969.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Song for my Father
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Omar Sosa AfroCubano Quarteto
programme.desc: To call Omar Sosa an Afro-Cuban jazz pianist would only capture part of his true style. Because while he has always kept one foot firmly within the traditions of his native isle, this citizen of the world also shows an insatiable curiosity, tirelessly exploring music from around the world: from the Caribbean to India and from West Africa to the Arab World. Nothing seems to escape his thirst for discovery.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Stranger than Paranoia
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Sing Jazz, Singapore
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Great Jazz Pianists
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Zara McFlaren
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: The Way it Goes
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: What Is This Thing Called Love
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quintet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis and his quintet performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Straight No Chaser
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: November Music 2017: Daniel Herskedal
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands. Norwegian tuba player and composer Daniel Herskedal trained at the Trondheim and Copenhagen Music Conservatories.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Quartet - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1991, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: My favourite things
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Bass solo
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Live in London
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, 'The Best Is Yet To Come,' 'Fly Me to the Moon,' and his signature song 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco.'.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: Jacques Kuba Séguin: L'étude des Lueurs
programme.desc: Trumpeter Jacques Kuba Séguin’s ensemble unites some of Montreal’s most expressive musicians: apart from Jacques Kuba Séguin, double bassist Frédéric Alarie, pianist Jonathan Cayer, and drummer Kevin Warren deliver subtle but strong lyrical moments, that make it hard not to be touched by the musical bond of this group. The experience of their ‘Litania Projekt’ seems to stop time for an instant.

programme.title: Recorda Me
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Alcazar de Sevilla
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Pedro Viáfora And Celso Viáfora
programme.desc: Pedro Viáfora and Celso Viáfora are a father-and-son duo that brings together different generations of Brazilian music. Celso is a renowned composer with an extensive discography, while Pedro began his career with the group 5 a Seco before developing his solo work.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: The New Conrad Miller Trio Live at Mocher's
programme.desc: Full-time pianist, composer, teacher, and producer Coen Molenaar – aka Conrad Miller – is active all over the world in styles ranging as widely as jazz, fusion, dance, funk, RAndB, rock, and neo-soul. In this 2021 performance from Rossini Studios in Stuttgart, Germany, Miller plays contemporary trio jazz with his bandmates David de Marez Oyens (double bass) and Enrique Firpi (drums).

programme.title: The last chieftain
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Hamilton e Laginha - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the duo of Hamilton and Laginha.

programme.title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64?highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer’s band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins’ band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Live at Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Dutch free jazz, jazz rock, and electronic music pioneer Pierre Courbois threw a belated 80th birthday bash at Amsterdam’s renowned BIMhuis in January 2022. Courbois, a celebrated drummer and percussionist, also masters the tabla, conga, bass guitar, and vibraphone, and is a prolific writer with over 100 compositions to his credit.

programme.title: The legendary American crooner
programme.desc: His charisma and impeccable phrasing placed him way ahead of the game: ‘The Voice’, Frank Sinatra. The legendary American crooner, who sang swing, jazz, and traditional pop, became one of the most popular and influential musical artists of the 20th century.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Gilberto, Gillespie And Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks And Company - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan And Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: A la Decouverte du Monde
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Media 9. 2024. Un film de Pierre Brouwers. Immense et très peu peuplé, le plus grand des états américains est le pays aux 100.000 glaciers, qui recouvrent 5 % de son territoire. Vus du ciel, les géants de glace sont d'une beauté inouïe, et lorsqu'on les découvre à l'aide de traîneaux à chiens ou en s'y posant en avions à ski, l'aventure réserve bien des surprises.

programme.title: Caméras Espions au Coeur des Océans
programme.desc: Série documentaire coproduite par PBS And THE WNET GROUP / John Downer Productions. 2024. Réalisation : John Downer. programme.title: Le Sri lanka, l'île aux Trésors
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Wall to Wall Media Ltd. 2023. Réalisation : Alex Burr, Tessa Chan, Ruth Campbell Des tropiques à l’Arctique, l’isolement et la vie entre terre et mer font des îles de véritables laboratoires naturels de la vie sauvage. L’histoire de leurs origines est essentielle pour découvrir leur impact sur les animaux qui tentent de survivre sur ces territoires.

programme.title: Escapades Aériennes en Italie
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Viacom International Inc. 2023. Un film de Toby Beach. Cette série propose une découverte vue du ciel des magnifiques paysages et de la richesse du patrimoine des différentes régions d'Italie. Cet épisode invite à découvrir le nord de l’Italie.

programme.title: Les Routes de l'impossible - Mongolie, les Irreductibles des...
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Tony Comiti Productions, avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2024. Réalisation : Philippe Lafaix. Dans les pays dont certaines régions sont très difficiles d'accès, cette série part à la rencontre de celles et ceux qui bravent tous les dangers au péril de leur vie. Pour eux, franchir ces routes de l'impossible est le seul moyen de gagner de quoi subsister. La morsure du froid est implacable.

programme.desc: Cristina faz um pedido a Rafael. Clarice flagra Raul. Rafael descobre que Guto quer confessar tudo. Débora arma um plano contra Guto. Xavier procura as joias.

Irma confessa que teme sua aproximação com Trindade. Guta demonstra interesse em saber sobre a outra família de Tenório. Túlio e José Lucas chegam à fazenda para jogar truco com os peões. Jove fala a Juma que o Velho do Rio é seu avô.

programme.desc: Mauro se revolta ao saber da chantagem de Melina. Cris conta para Laura sobre a chantagem de Melina. Lorena muda o seu depoimento na delegacia. Olavo não deixa Clô entrar em seu quarto. Berilo garante à Agostina que não tem mais nada com Jéssica. Bete repreende Melina por sentir ciúmes de Mauro e provoca Fred. Fátima convence Felícia a dar uma chance para Gerson. Gerson não consegue revelar para Flávio o seu segredo.

programme.desc: Jendal se irrita com as notícias de Malungo, que esconde do rei o fato de ter encontrado Alika. Kênia diz a Dumi que está pronta para se unir aos rebeldes contra Jendal. Maria Helena confessa a Dôra o motivo de ter se casado com Fortunato. Com receio das ameaças de Virgínia, Diógenes inventa uma desculpa para promover Mirinho no banco.

Brandão convoca Rômulo para uma conversa, mas Uirapuru chega.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 28
programme.desc: Pérola discute com Vanessa e acaba desmaiando diante da filha, que pede socorro médico. Gabriel diz a Peixe que pode ajudar o rapaz. Bela fala com a pediatra Íris sobre Samuca. Ricardo se responsabiliza pelo atendimento de Pérola. Vitor avisa a Leandra sobre a saúde de Pérola. Todos acabam descobrindo sobre a doença da empresária. Pérola implora para que Bela assuma a presidência do hospital.

programme.title: A Gata Comeu - Ep. 34

programme.desc: Juca desconfia de Zé Bolacha. Irene acorda e garante que tentaram matá-la. Lucas diz que vai passar a noite com Irene no hospital, mas ele começa a ter atitudes estranhas.

Rodrigo se decepciona com Roger. Maria descobre que Miguel é pai de Rodrigo. Artur atrapalha a reaproximação de Nanda e Filipe.
